fullPassage: The Venus flytrap, a meat-eating plant, has a pair of leaves that act as jaws and a stomach. If an insect touches the trigger hairs on the surface of these leaves, the leaves close, trapping the insect. Amazingly, a recent experiment showed that the Venus flytrap knew how many times its trigger hairs were touched and could even count the time between these stimuli. The trap closed only if the plant sensed two stimuli within a 20 second time span. Once 20 seconds passed, the process was reset. In addition, more than three stimuli were required for the plant to begin producing the enzymes that digest the trapped insect. Thanks to this process, the Venus flytrap doesn't make meaningless efforts trying to trap and digest raindrops or fallen leaves.

④ worthwhile: 빗방울을 가두는 것은 가치 있는 일이 아님
det.tip: 효소를 생산해(producing) 소화하고(digest), 먹이가 아닌 것엔 무의미한(meaningless) 노력을 하지 않음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: touch(동사: 건드리다) → touched(과거분사: 건드려진). were + p.p. 수동태 구문
det.analysis: touch를 과거분사 touched로 변환. 'its trigger hairs were touched'=감각모가 건드려졌다 — were + p.p. 수동태에서 과거분사가 필요
det.tip: were _____ → 수동태(be + p.p.) → touched

questions.passage: Thanks to this process, the Venus flytrap doesn't make meaningless efforts __________ (try) to trap and digest raindrops or fallen leaves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: try(동사: 시도하다) → trying(현재분사: 시도하는). 앞 명사를 수식·부연하는 분사구문
det.analysis: try를 현재분사 trying으로 변환. 'meaningless efforts trying to trap'=가두려 시도하는 무의미한 노력 — 명사를 수식하는 현재분사(-ing)가 필요
det.tip: efforts _____ to ~ → 능동 의미의 현재분사(-ing) → trying

questions.passage: The Venus flytrap, a meat-eating plant, has a pair of leaves that act as jaws and a stomach. If an insect touches the trigger hairs on the surface of these leaves, the leaves close, trapping the insect. Amazingly, a recent experiment showed that the Venus flytrap knew how many times its trigger hairs were touched and could even count the time between these stimuli. The trap closed only if the plant sensed two stimuli within a 20 second time span. Once 20 seconds passed, the process was reset. In addition, more than three stimuli were required for the plant to begin producing the enzymes that digest the trapped insect. Thanks to this process, the Venus flytrap doesn't make __________ trying to trap and digest raindrops or fallen leaves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: meaningless efforts=무의미한 노력 / careful plans=신중한 계획 / quick decisions=빠른 결정 / strong signals=강한 신호
det.analysis:
① meaningless efforts: 빗방울·낙엽을 가두려는 헛수고를 하지 않는다는 흐름 ←정답
② careful plans: 신중한 계획 — 뒤 문맥(빗방울을 안 가둠)과 안 맞음
③ quick decisions: 빠른 결정 — 문맥 부적절
④ strong signals: 강한 신호 — 문맥 부적절
det.tip: 빗방울·낙엽(먹이 아님)엔 반응 안 함 → 헛된 무의미한 노력(meaningless efforts)을 안 함

questions.passage: The Venus flytrap, a meat-eating plant, has a pair of leaves that act as jaws and a stomach. If an insect touches the trigger hairs on the surface of these leaves, the leaves close, trapping the insect. Amazingly, a recent experiment showed that the Venus flytrap knew how many times its trigger hairs were touched and could even count the time between these stimuli. The trap closed only if the plant sensed two stimuli within a 20 second time span. Once 20 seconds passed, the process was reset. In addition, more than three stimuli were required for the plant to begin producing the enzymes that digest the __________. Thanks to this process, the Venus flytrap doesn't make meaningless efforts trying to trap and digest raindrops or fallen leaves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fallen leaves=낙엽 / trapped insect=갇힌 곤충 / green stems=초록 줄기 / trigger hairs=감각모
det.analysis:
① fallen leaves: 낙엽 — 마지막 문장에서 소화하지 '않는' 대상
② trapped insect: 효소가 소화하는 대상은 덫에 갇힌 곤충 ←정답
③ green stems: 초록 줄기 — 문맥과 무관
④ trigger hairs: 감각모 — 소화 대상이 아니라 감각 기관
det.tip: enzymes that digest(소화하는 효소)의 대상 = 갇힌 먹이인 trapped insect(갇힌 곤충)
